compatibility.identifier_policy: Active RFC and object identifiers retain their meaning throughout the 1.x line and are never silently reused.
compatibility.schema_policy: Backward-compatible additions may use 1.x; breaking normative, schema, protocol, or identifier changes require 2.0 and migration notes.
compatibility.npm_role: Primary TypeScript CLI for discovery, resolution, intake, and planning; Python 3.9 remains a temporary compatibility backend for unported commands and release validators.

unsupported_capabilities: Independent external review of the normative RFC profile
known_limitations: The stable specification was internally reviewed; independent external normative review has not yet been completed.
Reviewed examples use the declared project review contract and are not independent external evaluations.
The checked-in benchmark runner preserves execution evidence but the repository contains no public comparative model-quality result.
The optional OpenAI adapter requires explicit live opt-in and credentials; release verification is offline.
The TypeScript migration is incomplete: source creation, lifecycle, adapter, workflow, benchmark, and release commands still require the Python compatibility backend.
Release provenance is anchored by the v1.1.0 tag, specification revision, and generated registry source revision.
